knownCredentialScan: All copied/generated pack bytes checked with the existing private key and finite known-value scanner; no key value/hash copied or printed.
limits: Two historical initial test versions survive as hash/log bindings only; their exact original test snapshots are missing. The current source and corrected guard-order fixture/old source are preserved separately.
The guard receives a frozen base session context before the current runId, composed signal and clientOrigin are added; it is not final dispatch context or an actual filesystem grant receipt.
Existing guard runs first, fresh current guard last. validateContext already calls beforeToolCall; future wiring must not add it a second time.
The guard is before tool.run but after legacy pre-scan/approval and does not authorize earlier metadata import, MCP startup or arbitrary-code spawn. Lifecycle begin failure is not a denial gate.
No atomic ACL/effect transaction, durable lease, runtime confinement, persisted-wrapper integration, AgentService/HTTP/UI activation or Hermes parity is established.
